dataset: Official CAMUS_public Girder collection 6373703d73e9f0047faa1bc8, annotated ED/ES frames only
selection: Highest validation native-grid foreground macro-Dice, earliest tie
primary: Test patient mean foreground macro-Dice over all labelled qualities
secondary: native-grid HD95 and ASSD in mm
test_policy: One evaluation of the selected checkpoint after the fixed training budget; no tuning against test results
scope: One complete baseline run; not a multi-seed study, external validation, or clinical validation
